actions.summary: The goal is to unblock the UI implementation in public/ by integrating the Keeper functionality. Based on the GDD and existing structure, the next logical step is to implement the Keeper interface logic within the Game class in src/engine/Game.ts, allowing the UI to transition to the KEEPER_INTERFACE state. I will add the necessary state management and a placeholder for the Keeper logic hook. I will also update public/index.html to listen for the KEEPER_INTERFACE state and display a placeholder UI element, fulfilling the 'unblock UI implementation' requirement.
